The 411 product slugs were regex-searched for mirror|bath|soap|towel|toilet|tooth|shower|basin|wash|sink|sanit - a single hit, /products/tray-sc64-sc65, which is the Collect serving tray under Tableware. Objects holds 50 products in total and every one is decor, textile, tableware or care product.
